settings.agent_tools_desc: Manage Partner tools, toggle or configure tool parameters
settings.mcp_custom_desc: Add an external Streamable HTTP /mcp URL. When enabled, this device’s Agent can call its tools. /sse is not supported.
settings.mcp_custom_always_allow_desc: When enabled, companion executes all tools from this service (including write actions) without asking for confirmation
settings.mcp_desc: Allow external AI to call BaiShou tools via MCP protocol
settings.mcp_workspace_suffix_hint: All workspaces are exposed simultaneously. Each workspace has its own ?vault=<workspaceId> URL so you can connect multiple workspaces at once.
settings.mcp_help_intro: When MCP is enabled, BaiShou runs a local MCP server so external AI clients (e.g. Cursor) can use diary, memory, and other tools.
settings.mcp_auth_enable_desc: When enabled, clients must send an access token
settings.mcp_auto_approve_desc: When enabled, external clients can run this device's tools (including writes/deletes) without confirmation. Only use on trusted networks.
settings.mcp_help_json_1: Open MCP JSON settings in your client and add a server under mcpServers.
settings.mcp_help_json_2: Set url to the connection URL above; if auth is enabled, add headers.Authorization as Bearer <token>.
settings.mcp_help_cursor_1: Open or create Cursor global config (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\mcp.json, macOS/Linux: ~/.cursor/mcp.json).
settings.mcp_help_cursor_2: Paste the config below into mcpServers (prefer /mcp; use /sse for legacy SSE clients), then restart Cursor or refresh MCP.
settings.mcp_help_cursor_2_mobile: Paste the config below into mcpServers (use the /mcp URL above), then restart Cursor or refresh MCP.
settings.mcp_help_vscode_1: In an extension that supports MCP, add a remote MCP server.
settings.mcp_help_vscode_2: Set the server URL to the connection URL above, then reload the window or reconnect MCP.
settings.mcp_help_note: Prefer /mcp; use /sse only when the client lacks Streamable HTTP support. Keep the BaiShou desktop app running while connected.
settings.mcp_help_note_mobile: On mobile, use the /mcp URL (Streamable HTTP). Keep the BaiShou mobile app running and stay on the same LAN.
settings.mcp_view_tools_desc: View the list of built-in tools (such as diary and memory management) exposed by the MCP server
settings.mcp_refresh_token_message: The old token will stop working immediately. External clients must update their Authorization header. Continue?
settings.mcp_help_auth_note: If an access token is generated, set headers.Authorization to Bearer <token> or tools/list will fail.
settings.mcp_help_auth_disabled_note: Authentication is off; no Authorization header is required. Use only on trusted networks.
settings.mcp_custom_tools_test_hint: Tap "Test connection" to fetch all tools
settings.agent_behavior_desc: Global context window, compression thresholds, and persona
settings.agent_persona_hint: Role and personality of the agent
settings.agent_persona_placeholder: e.g. You are an AI companion helping the user review diaries.
settings.agent_guidelines_hint: Behavior rules the agent should follow
settings.agent_guidelines_placeholder: e.g. Use tools to read diaries; do not fabricate facts.
settings.agent_gate_desc: Control whether sensitive companion actions require your confirmation.
settings.agent_security_mode_hint: Applies to all workspaces. Blacklisted commands always require confirmation.
settings.agent_security_full_access_hint: Run automatically when possible; blacklisted commands still ask
settings.agent_security_allow_list_hint: Ask by default; only Always-allow commands run automatically
settings.agent_gate_command_blacklist_hint: Matching shell commands always ask and cannot be “Always allow”. Defaults include high-risk patterns like git push --force and rm -rf.
settings.agent_gate_blacklist_page_hint: Applies globally. Matching commands always ask and cannot be Always allow.
settings.agent_gate_blacklist_restore_hint: Restore to recommended blacklisted command patterns without affecting the allow list.
settings.agent_gate_allowlist_page_hint: Used by Allow list mode. Entries appear after you choose Always allow in chat.
settings.agent_gate_command_allowlist_empty: No entries yet. Use Always allow in chat to add one.
settings.agent_gate_auto_review_parse_failed: Auto review could not parse the model response
settings.agent_gate_auto_review_no_model: No usable model configured; confirmation is required
settings.agent_gate_auto_review_failed: Auto review failed; confirmation is required
settings.agent_gate_auto_review_incomplete: Auto review could not finish; your confirmation is required.
settings.agent_gate_matrix_hint: Choose Allow, Ask, or Deny per capability. Denied tools can be hidden from the model below.
settings.agent_gate_cap_browse_hint: List and read files inside the workspace
settings.agent_gate_cap_delete_hint: Delete files in the workspace; can be set to allow, ask, or deny
settings.agent_gate_cap_command_hint: Host commands; cannot allow wholesale—only safe prefixes
settings.agent_gate_cap_external_hint: Default policy for paths outside the workspace; trusted dirs can be added
settings.agent_gate_cap_diary_delete_hint: Deleting diary entries always requires confirmation
settings.agent_gate_cap_summary_write_hint: Create or update weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly summaries
settings.agent_gate_cap_skill_write_hint: Create or update a software-level skill
settings.agent_gate_cap_skill_read_hint: List available skills or read SKILL.md instructions
settings.agent_gate_trusted_dirs_hint: Matching outside paths follow Allow rules; unmatched still ask or deny.
settings.agent_gate_command_prefixes_hint: From Always allow in chat; this workspace only.
settings.agent_gate_notifications_hint: When the companion needs you to confirm an action, send a system notification. Turning the switch on sends a preview.
settings.agent_gate_notify_unsupported: This system does not support notifications
settings.agent_gate_notify_preview_failed: The notification preview could not be shown. Check system notification permission.
settings.agent_gate_allowlist_empty: No entries yet. Use Always allow in chat to add one.
settings.agent_gate_allowlist_hint: Applies to companion sessions only; not workbench.
settings.agent_gate_advanced_hint: For users familiar with action/pattern rules; safe to ignore day-to-day.
settings.agent_gate_scope_preset_hint: How far the AI can reach in this workspace
settings.agent_gate_rule_order_hint: Order is priority: later overrides earlier
settings.agent_gate_custom_hint: Fine-tune allow / ask / deny per capability; switching the security mode above overwrites these rules
settings.agent_gate_custom_active_hint: Fine-tuned rules are active; choosing a preset above will overwrite them
settings.agent_gate_advanced_toggle_hint: Scene defaults, always-ask list, and extra rules
